title: Binance Futures Will List USDⓈ-M BTC & ETH Quarterly 1230 Futures Contracts
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will list USDⓈ-M BTC and ETH Quarterly 1230 Contracts at 2022-09-23 02:30 (UTC). USDⓈ-M Quarterly 0930 Contracts will expire and settle at 2022-09-30 08:00 (UTC). Notes: Users are only allowed to close their positions or place Reduce Only orders and are not allowed to open any new positions ten minutes prior to delivery. For further information, please refer to  Delivery and Settlement of Quarterly Futures .  Thanks for your support!
